Create your 14-day free trial account in the app

EchoDesk signup happens in the mobile app — not by email. After you confirm your address, come back to the app to finish onboarding.

1. Open the EchoDesk app

Use the installed iOS or Android build on your phone.

2. Tap Start free trial / Create account

Sign up with your email and password inside the app.

3. Confirm your email, then return to the app

The confirmation link opens a short handoff page and then EchoDesk. If that fails, open the app and sign in with the same email.
